description:
FOUND s513f (Opus, 2026-10-09) while building #2874 (`use bigrat` is ANNOUNCED instead of built because of this). Probe scratch/s513f/pr/bf1.pl in the s513f worktree:
    use Math::BigRat; my $r = Math::BigRat->new("1/3"); print $r + Math::BigRat->new("1/6"), "\n"; print Math::BigRat->new("3/4") * 2, "\n";
perl 5.40.3: 1/2 / 3/2.  PCL (s513f tree): 2 / dies "Unhandled sb-int:simple-program-error" (an arity error inside a transpiled core-module sub -- not tidy, not perl's).  Math::BigInt and Math::BigFloat answer the same shapes correctly (bigint/bignum shims work).  When it runs, lib/bigrat.pm becomes the same three lines as lib/bignum.pm (overload::constant integer/float/binary => \&NAME with Math::BigRat->new).

=== s543t (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28): THE TWO ROWS ARE RIGHT ===
`Math::BigRat->new("1/3") + Math::BigRat->new("1/6")` -> 1/2 and `Math::BigRat->new("3/4") * 2` -> 3/2 on the s543t tree (perl the same; the raw condition was already gone on cababb9d, which answered 2 and 2).  The cause was #2560 (= #932's sub half), fixed there.  `use bigrat` stays ANNOUNCED (lib/bigrat.pm; the brief left it): its comment's reason "Math::BigRat does not run" is now stale -- shipping bigrat as bignum's three lines is the open step (Rosetta 0994 is keyed NS:ns-bigint on it).
subject: Math::BigRat does not run under PCL: Math::BigRat->new("1/3") + Math::BigRat->new("1/6") gives 2 (perl 1/2), Math::BigRat->new("3/4") * 2 dies with a raw sb-int:simple-program-error
triage_reason: Math::BigRat arithmetic (one family with #2560; bigrat is shipped)
